verdict.line: You lose this if you trade into Yorick's Q sustain and walker chip over and over; you win it by forcing short all-in windows with Q's shockwave pull and W's stun right after he's spent his wall.

brief.thesis: Yorick's kit is built for prolonged skirmishing: Q (Last Rites) heals him on every cast, E (Mourning Mist) marks you so his Mist Walkers speed up and pile on, and W (Dark Procession) drops a wall that lets him choose exactly when a fight starts or ends. K'Sante's trade pattern is the opposite — short all-in bursts off Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks and a telegraphed W (Path Maker) charge-dash. Extended lane trades favor Yorick's sustain and walker chip, which is exactly why K'Sante sits at 38.7% over 62 games here against a 47% baseline in the role, and why Yorick holds both lane and solo-kill advantage.

theirWindow.when: His Q is up with walkers nearby
theirWindow.what: Last Rites empowers his next attack and heals him on hit, and his Mist Walkers are chipping you for free. Disengage rather than trading through it — you lose the extended exchange.

yourWindow.when: Your Q is at 2 stacks and W is ready
yourWindow.what: The 2-stack shockwave from Ntofo Strikes pulls Yorick to you — use it to drag him out of his own Dark Procession wall, then immediately follow with W's charge-dash stun before he can reset the zone.

start.why: The regen and damage-block on it offsets Yorick's auto-attack walker chip better than a pure damage start, and it's the higher-measured win rate of the two listed starts (41.7% over 12 games).

boots.why: Walkers and his Q-empowered autos are all basic-attack damage, so flat reduction blunts the chip harder than tenacity would — also the standard pick at 78.1%.

core.why: Gives Q (Ntofo Strikes) a slow proc to lock Yorick down before he can wall away, plus early HP/mana to survive the sustain race.
Omnivamp and the damage-reduction shield let you out-sustain his Q (Last Rites) healing and walker chip instead of trying to race it.
Stacks healing power on top of Unending Despair's omnivamp; this exact path measured the best win rate in the core build data (66.7% over 3 games).

situational.when: yorick leans on autos and walker swarms to win extended fights
you need healing reduction early to blunt his Q (Last Rites) sustain
his walkers or attack-speed items are stacking up swarm damage
the game goes long and you need flat damage reduction in teamfights

runes.keystoneWhy: The on-hit heal offsets walker chip and the Q (Last Rites) healing race better than a damage keystone, since you can't out-trade his sustain directly early.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you prioritize plates and side-lane tempo instead of forcing repeated trades you're statistically losing (38.7% head-to-head), and it's the dominant pick at 82.7%.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown
playing.detail: Last Rites empowers his next attack and heals him on hit; never extend a trade while it's up.

playing.title: Farm Q stacks for the pull
playing.detail: Two stacks of Q (Ntofo Strikes) fire a shockwave that pulls Yorick in — use it to drag him out of his own Dark Procession wall before committing further.

playing.title: Punish right after his W is spent
playing.detail: Dark Procession is his only disengage/zoning tool; commit your all-in the moment he's dropped a wall, not before.

playing.title: Leave marked waves immediately
playing.detail: Mourning Mist marks you and speeds his Mist Walkers toward that mark — back out of the wave the instant you're hit by it.

playing.title: Build anti-heal early
playing.detail: Bramble Vest or Thornmail's grievous wounds caps the healing he gets from every Q (Last Rites) cast, which is the core of his sustain edge.

playing.title: All-in right at level 6
playing.detail: All Out's knockback can throw Yorick through his own wall, stripping the escape tool he depends on — this is your best forced-fight window before he outscales you.

playing.title: Default to teleport siege
playing.detail: Given the losing head-to-head, prioritize side-lane plates and tempo over repeated skirmishes you're likely to lose.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 38.7% win-rate figure are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the matchup.
